name: @urban-signal/product
description: Urban Signal marketing and learning site

scripts.dev: bun run facts:export && node scripts/build.mjs && python3 -m http.server 4173 -d dist
scripts.facts:export: sh -c 'PY=""; if [ -n "$VIRTUAL_ENV" ] && [ -x "$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python" ]; then PY="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python"; elif [ -x "../../.venv/bin/python" ]; then PY="../../.venv/bin/python"; elif [ -x "../../apps/api/.venv/bin/python" ]; then PY="../../apps/api/.venv/bin/python"; else PY=python3; fi; PYTHONPATH=../../apps/api "$PY" ../../scripts/export_site_facts.py'
scripts.facts:check: sh -c 'PY=""; if [ -n "$VIRTUAL_ENV" ] && [ -x "$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python" ]; then PY="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python"; elif [ -x "../../.venv/bin/python" ]; then PY="../../.venv/bin/python"; elif [ -x "../../apps/api/.venv/bin/python" ]; then PY="../../apps/api/.venv/bin/python"; else PY=python3; fi; PYTHONPATH=../../apps/api "$PY" ../../scripts/export_site_facts.py --check'
scripts.lint: bun run facts:check && node scripts/build.mjs && node ../../scripts/verify-site-content.mjs && node scripts/verify-agent-surface.mjs && node scripts/verify-multi-page.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node --check worker.mjs && node --check src/main.js && node --check src/webmcp.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/html-to-markdown.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-agent-surfaces.mjs && node --check scripts/mcp-tools.mjs && node --check scripts/shell.mjs
